content:
Payment API টেস্ট করা সবচেয়ে সংবেদনশীল কাজগুলোর একটি। একটি ভুল মানে আর্থিক ক্ষতি, Duplicate charge, বা refund না হওয়া। Sandbox/Mock environment ব্যবহার করে প্রতিটি scenario নিখুঁতভাবে পরীক্ষা করতে হয়।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-PAY-001: Successful payment with valid card
Method: POST /api/payments/charge
Body:
{
  "orderId": "ORD-001",
  "amount": 1500.00,
  "currency": "BDT",
  "cardToken": "tok_visa_success"
}
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Response: { "transactionId": "TXN-...", "status": "SUCCESS" }
  - Order status updated to "PAID" in database

TC-PAY-002: Payment with bKash/Nagad mobile wallet
Body: { "method": "bkash", "walletNumber": "01712345678", ... }
Expected: 200 OK, transaction reference received
---

Negative Test Cases

TC-PAY-003: Insufficient balance
Card token: "tok_chargeDeclined"
Expected:
  - Status: 402 Payment Required
  - Message: "Payment declined. Insufficient funds."
  - Order status remains "PENDING"

TC-PAY-004: Invalid card number
Body: { "cardToken": "invalid_token" }
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "Invalid payment method."

TC-PAY-005: Expired card
Card token: "tok_expired"
Expected: 402, "Your card has expired."

TC-PAY-006: Zero or negative amount
Body: { "amount": 0 } or { "amount": -500 }
Expected: 400, "Amount must be greater than zero."

TC-PAY-007: Missing orderId
Expected: 400, "Order ID is required."
---

Critical Edge Cases

TC-PAY-008: Duplicate transaction (same orderId submitted twice)
Steps: Send same payment request twice within 5 seconds
Expected:
  - Second request returns 409 Conflict
  - Message: "This order has already been paid."
  - Money deducted only ONCE (Idempotency check)

TC-PAY-009: Gateway timeout simulation
Simulate payment gateway taking 30+ seconds
Expected:
  - API returns 504 Gateway Timeout after X seconds
  - Transaction NOT marked as SUCCESS
  - Order status remains PENDING for retry

TC-PAY-010: Partial payment attempt
Body: { "amount": 500 } when order total is 1500
Expected: 400, "Partial payment not allowed." (or 200 if supported)
---

Refund Test Cases

TC-PAY-011: Full refund for successful transaction
Method: POST /api/payments/refund
Body: { "transactionId": "TXN-001", "reason": "Customer request" }
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Refund initiated, reference ID returned
  - Original transaction status: "REFUNDED"

TC-PAY-012: Refund for already refunded transaction
Expected: 409 Conflict, "This transaction has already been refunded."
---

পরিশেষে

Payment API-এর সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ টেস্ট হলো Idempotency — একই request দুইবার পাঠালে দুইবার charge হওয়া উচিত নয়। Gateway timeout এবং Partial payment scenarios — এগুলো অনেক QA মিস করেন, কিন্তু Production-এ এগুলোই সবচেয়ে বড় সমস্যা তৈরি করে।

Tags: #PaymentAPI #APITesting #Idempotency #GatewayTimeout #Refund #FinTech #QA
